user.title: Connect to MATRIX EEG
user.description: Username and password are shown in the device assistant of the MATRIX EEG platform.

data_description.url: Default mqtts://mqtt.matrix.ctl.digital:8883. Allowed are mqtts://, mqtt:// (only for tests or a local broker) and wss://…/mqtt.

entities.title: Choose entities
entities.description: Which entities belong to the heat pump?

data_description.dhw_temp: A sensor or a water heater (its current temperature).
data_description.power: Optional, sensor in W or kW.
data_description.heater_rod: Optional. While the heater rod runs, the platform aborts a boost.
data_description.dhw_max: Optional. The setpoint is never set above this value.
data_description.limit_c: The integration never sets a higher setpoint, at most 60 °C.

error.invalid_url: Invalid URL. Allowed are mqtts://, mqtt:// and wss:// with a host name.
